identity.title: Publish user documentation and verify the exact GitHub clone

origin.kind: user request and current documentation implementation
origin.summary: The user requested a current README, a first-time user tutorial, documented utilities, and proof that the project works when obtained by itself from GitHub.

state.current_summary: Published user documentation and setup/package-script changes as implementation commit f7e43d96e8a5ff95206e3b703cd6e125fb0444e1 on origin/main. A clean D-backed GitHub HTTPS clone matched that remote commit, used only repository-vendored Lib.ThreeD and WPG packages, built Release with zero warnings and errors, produced a clean self-contained package with complete manifest and recipe references, and passed the packaged Shell check without a valid system DOTNET_ROOT.

objective.summary: Publish the completed user documentation on GitHub and prove that the exact remote revision builds and runs without an adjacent Library-Noah checkout.
constraints: Do not push without explicit user authorization.
Use only dependencies vendored in OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio.
Store fresh-clone verification outputs physically on D:.
Rebuild the distributable package from a clean commit.

criteria.text: The intended documentation and script changes are committed and remote main resolves to the same commit.
A fresh clone of that remote commit restores and builds Release with zero errors using only repository-vendored packages.
A clean-commit self-contained package has no missing or mismatched manifest payloads and all bundled recipe source references resolve.
The packaged Shell command-line verification passes with an invalid system DOTNET_ROOT.

context.summary: Remote main was independently cloned and built before this documentation slice.
The current local package reports gitWorkingTree=dirty by design and is verification evidence, not a distributable release.

artifacts.summary: Local setup, build, package, manifest, recipe-reference, Markdown-link, and self-contained Shell evidence.

evidence.observation: Local implementation commit, origin/main, and the fresh GitHub clone all resolved to f7e43d96e8a5ff95206e3b703cd6e125fb0444e1; the clone was clean with 929 tracked files and no tracked private fixture paths.

The clean GitHub clone passed Build-scope setup 4/4, contained all six required vendored package/configuration files, had zero external Library-Noah project/config references, and built Release with zero warnings and zero errors.

The clean-commit self-contained package recorded the exact clone commit and clean working tree, matched all 502 manifest payload paths, sizes, and SHA-256 values, resolved 12/12 recipe source references, matched 3/3 packaged documentation sources, and distributed no corrupt fixtures.
With DOTNET_ROOT set to a missing path and multilevel lookup disabled, the packaged Shell exited 0 and passed its command-line verification 31/31.

events.summary: The user documentation was published and the exact implementation commit passed the clean GitHub-clone, build, package-integrity, recipe-reference, and self-contained execution gates.
